prompt: I have no protective puts on yet. Put on a hedge program for my $200k portfolio. It's tech-heavy (PLTR 27%, TSLA 13%, NVDA 8%, MSTR and COIN significant). Budget is $800/month per my Layer 3 allocation.

assertions.text: YAML contains total_premium_outlay and monthly_amortized_cost fields with numeric values
Execution Summary table contains BUY TO OPEN legs (at least 2 contracts, likely 4 per $50k sizing rule)
Contract count approximately 4 total ($200k / $50k per contract)
Multi-underlying allocation reflects tech-heavy adjustment: QQQ weight ≥50%, SPY 30-40%, IWM ≤10% or dropped
Strike selection noted as 10-20% OTM per framework
DTE target 25-35 days per OPEN workflow step 4
Monthly amortized cost ≤ $800 budget (framework check passes)
Sizing Rationale section cites hedging-strategies.md framework
Educational disclaimer with options-specific language (premium loss risk)
First Roll Trigger section specifies a date 5-7 days before expiry
